blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-based tactile sensors provide rich contact information, but processing high-resolution images can be costly for resource-constrained platforms such as space robots. This work investigates whether a compact representation of tactile motion can classify object rotation across different gravity conditions. Dense optical flow from a simulated GelSight Mini is aggregated over a 7x9 grid into 126 features and used to classify the direction of load-induced rotation under Earth, Mars, Moon, and orbital gravity. Gravity causes a small but significant shift in these features, accounting for 1.6% of their variance (R2 = 0.016). Despite its small magnitude, this shift affects models trained only on Earth data: XGBoost accuracy decreases from 94.4% on Earth to 75.9% in orbit. In contrast, a single model trained across all four gravity domains achieves 96.3% overall accuracy and 95.1%-97.0% across individual domains, without using gravity as an input. The representation can also be reduced to 40 features while retaining 95.7% accuracy, with XGBoost requiring only 0.14 ms per inference. These findings show that Earth-gravity performance alone is insufficient to establish the transferability of tactile perception for space robotic manipulation, highlighting the need to account for gravity-induced domain shifts during training and validation.
blocks.zh: 基于视觉的触觉传感器提供了丰富的联系信息,但处理高分辨率图像对于像空间机器人这样的资源约束平台来说可能代价高昂. 这项工作调查了触觉运动的紧凑表现是否能够将物体在不同重力条件下旋转分类. 模拟的GelSight Mini光学流在7x9网格上聚合成126个特征,并用于对地球,火星,月球和轨道重力下负载引起的旋转方向进行分类. 引力导致这些特征发生小而显著的变化,占其差异的1.6%(R2=0.016). 尽管其规模较小,但这一转变影响到只培训过关于地球数据的模型:XGBoost精度从地球的94.4%下降到轨道的75.9%。 与此相反,在所有四个重力领域培训的单一模型总精度为96.3%,单个领域为95.1%-97.0%,而没有将重力作为投入。 表示还可以缩小为40个特性,同时保留95.7%的精确度,XGBoost每推论只需要0.14ms. 这些研究结果表明,单靠地球重力性能不足以确定空间机器人操纵的触觉感知的可转移性,这突出表明了在培训和验证过程中需要考虑到重力引起的域位转移。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Contact-rich manipulation is essential for space robotic operations such as on-orbit servicing [ 1 ] , in-space assembly, maintenance, inspection, and planetary sample collection [ 2 ] . These operations require robots to interpret local contact under limited sensing, uncertain object properties, and gravity conditions that differ from those on Earth. Reliable contact perception is therefore important for safe robotic manipulation [ 3 ] . Vision-based tactile sensors offer a promising solution by converting local contact interactions into high-resolution images [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 接触丰富的操纵对空间机器人操作至关重要,如在轨服务[1]、空间装配、维护、检查和行星样本收集[2]。 这些操作要求机器人在有限的感知,不确定的物体属性,重力条件与地球不同的情况下解释局部接触. 因此,可靠的接触感对于安全的机器人操纵非常重要[3]. 基于视觉的触觉传感器通过将局部接触相互作用转换为高分辨率图像,提供了一个很有希望的解决办法 [4].

blocks.en: While these images provide rich contact information, processing them directly can be computationally expensive for resource-constrained platforms such as space robots. Compact representations can reduce this computational burden. In particular, optical flow captures tactile motion using a reduced set of features and has been used to estimate displacement, deformation, geometry, and force, as well as for lightweight classification tasks [ 5 ] .
blocks.zh: 虽然这些图像提供了丰富的联系信息,但对于诸如空间机器人等受资源限制的平台来说,直接处理它们可能计算成本昂贵. 契约表述可以减轻这种计算负担. 特别是光学流利用被缩小的一组特征来捕捉触觉运动,并被用来估计迁移,变形,几何和力,以及轻量级分类任务[5].

blocks.en: However, tactile perception methods are typically developed and validated under Earth gravity. Changes in gravity affect object dynamics and may therefore alter the tactile signals observed during manipulation. Consequently, a representation or classifier that performs well on Earth may not transfer directly to reduced-gravity environments. This is particularly relevant for space robotics, where tactile perception systems must operate under conditions that are difficult to reproduce and validate experimentally on Earth.
blocks.zh: 然而,触觉感知方法通常是在地心引力下得到发展和验证. 重力的变化会影响物体动力学,因此可能改变被操纵时所观察到的触觉信号. 因此,在地球上表现良好的代表或分类器可能不会被直接转移到地重力环境。 这与空间机器人特别相关,在空间机器人中,触觉感知系统必须在地球上难以复制和实验验证的条件下运行.

blocks.en: Fig. 1 : Multi-gravity scenarios considered in this work and overview of the investigated transfer problem.
blocks.zh: 图1:本作中考虑的多重力情景和被调查的转移问题概述.

blocks.en: Therefore, this work investigates two questions: (1) whether a compact representation of tactile motion is sufficient to classify a manipulation event, and (2) whether its performance transfers across gravity conditions. These questions are studied in simulation using the load-induced rotation of a grasped object as a controlled interaction event. The direction of rotation describes how the object moves relative to the grasp and can provide information for corrective manipulation before grasp stability is compromised. Unlike a wrist-mounted force/torque sensor, tactile sensing observes this motion directly at the contact interface and preserves its local spatial structure.
blocks.zh: 因此,这项工作调查了两个问题:(1) 紧凑地表示触觉运动是否足以将操纵事件分类,(2) 其性能是否跨越重力条件转移. 这些问题在模拟中用被抓住物体的负载所引发的旋转作为可控相互作用事件来研究. 旋转的方向描述了物体相对于被抓住的移动方式,并且能够在被抓住稳定性损害之前为纠正操纵提供信息. 与手腕挂起力/托克传感器不同,触觉感知直接在接触界面上观测到这种运动,并保留其局部空间结构.

blocks.en: The tactile response is represented by dense optical flow between consecutive frames of a simulated GelSight Mini. The flow field is spatially aggregated over a fixed grid and used as input to lightweight classifiers, without providing gravity as an input. The same interaction task and representation are evaluated under Earth, Mars, Moon, and orbital gravity. This controlled setup allows us to measure how gravity affects the tactile representation and whether this domain shift affects classification performance (Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 触觉反应由模拟的GelSight Mini相继相框之间的密集光学流来代表. 流场在一个固定的网格上被空间相接并用作轻量级分级器的输入,而不会提供重力作为输入. 在地球、火星、月球和轨道重力下评价了同样的相互作用任务和代表性。 这种可控设置使我们能够衡量重力如何影响触觉表示以及这个域位移是否影响分类性能(图一.

blocks.en: The analysis first quantifies the effect of gravity on the optical-flow representation. Classifiers trained only under Earth gravity are then evaluated on unseen gravity domains to assess cross-gravity generalization. Finally, a single model is trained using data from all four gravity conditions, followed by an ablation study to determine how far the tactile representation can be reduced while preserving classification performance.
blocks.zh: 分析首先量化了重力对光流表示的影响. 然后对仅在地心引力下训练的分类器在看不见的重力域上进行评估,以评估跨重力通论。 最后,使用来自所有四个重力条件的数据对单一模型进行培训,然后进行减速研究,以确定在保持分类性能的同时可在多大程度上减少触觉能表现.

blocks.en: The main contributions are: • A quantitative analysis of the gravity-induced domain shift in a compact tactile optical-flow representation, showing that classifiers trained only under Earth gravity lose accuracy under unseen reduced-gravity conditions. • A cross-gravity classification approach based on a single model trained across Earth, Mars, Moon, and orbital gravity, achieving consistent performance across all four domains without requiring gravity as an input. • A reduced optical-flow representation of 40 features that retains 95.7% accuracy, less than one percentage point below the full 126-feature representation.
blocks.zh: 主要贡献是: • 在紧凑的触觉光流表现中,对重力引起的域位转移进行定量分析,显示仅在地心重力下训练的分类器在看不见的减重条件下失去准确性. 二. 支助 采用跨重力分类方法,采用在地球、火星、月球和轨道重力上经过训练的单一模型,在所有四个领域实现一致的性能,而不需要重力作为投入。 二. 支助 光学流能代表被降低为40个特性,保留了95.7%的精度,比完整的126个地貌代表差不到一个百分点.

blocks.en: A quantitative analysis of the gravity-induced domain shift in a compact tactile optical-flow representation, showing that classifiers trained only under Earth gravity lose accuracy under unseen reduced-gravity conditions.
blocks.zh: 在紧凑的触觉光电流表现中,对重力引起的域位转移进行定量分析,表明仅在地心重力下训练的分类器在看不见的减重条件下失去准确性。

blocks.en: A cross-gravity classification approach based on a single model trained across Earth, Mars, Moon, and orbital gravity, achieving consistent performance across all four domains without requiring gravity as an input.
blocks.zh: 采用跨重力分类方法,采用在地球、火星、月球和轨道重力上经过训练的单一模型,在所有四个领域实现一致的性能,而不需要重力作为投入。

blocks.en: A reduced optical-flow representation of 40 features that retains 95.7% accuracy, less than one percentage point below the full 126-feature representation.
blocks.zh: 光学流能代表被降低为40个特性,保留了95.7%的精度,低于完整的126个地貌代表的一个百分点.

blocks.en: Together, these contributions provide a basis for developing computationally efficient tactile perception methods that account for gravity-domain shifts in space robotic manipulation.
blocks.zh: 这些贡献共同为制定计算效率高的触觉感知方法提供了基础,这种方法反映了空间机器人操纵中重力领域的变化。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Vision-Based Tactile Sensing
blocks.zh: II-A 以远景为基础的梯形传感器

blocks.en: Vision-based tactile sensors convert contact into images, either marker-based or intensity-based [ 6 ] , and have become a primary route to high-resolution touch for manipulation [ 7 ] . Sensors of this type measure the deformation of a soft elastomer with a camera and infer geometry, force, and slip from it [ 4 ] . Force-oriented reviews show that marker tracking, optical flow, physical modelling, and learning-based methods are all used to estimate contact forces [ 8 ] , and recent learned estimators regress force distributions or 3D forces directly from vision-based tactile images [ 9 ] . Optical flow in particular has been used to estimate contact shape and force in DelTact [ 10 ] , force, geometry, and depth in GelFlow [ 5 ] , and 3D contact point clouds [ 11 ] . In contrast, this work evaluates a compact optical-flow representation of consecutive markerless tactile images for classifying the direction of load-induced rotation and analyses its transferability across gravity conditions.
blocks.zh: 基于视线的触觉传感器将接触转换为以标记为主或以强度为主的图像[6],并已成为高分辨率触摸的主要途径来进行操纵[7]. 这种类型的传感器用相机测量软弹性体的变形并引出几何,力,从中滑出[4]. 以力为取向的审查显示,标记跟踪,光学流,物理建模,和以学习为取向的方法都被用于估计接触力[8],而最近所学到的估算器直接从以视觉为取向的触觉图像中递减出力分布或3D力[9]. 光学流尤其被用于估算DelTact [10]中接触形状和力,力,几何,和GelFlow [5]中深度,和3D相接点云 [11]. 相比之下,这项工作评价了连续无标记触觉图像的紧凑光相流表现,用于对负载引起的自转方向进行分类,并分析其跨重力条件的可转移性.

blocks.en: II-B Tactile Simulation
blocks.zh: 二-B 试管模拟

blocks.en: Tactile simulation enables controlled, reproducible datasets without real hardware. TACTO [ 12 ] , Taxim [ 13 ] , and TacSL [ 14 ] render vision-based tactile images from simulated contact, and SimTacLS extends the idea to large-scale tactile skin [ 15 ] . Models trained on simulated tactile images do not transfer to real sensors by default, and the gap is addressed with physically accurate simulation [ 16 ] or domain adaptation [ 17 ] . The present study uses TacEx, which combines contact simulation with tactile rendering in Isaac Sim for GelSight Mini [ 18 ] , and it treats gravity as the domain variable of interest rather than the sim-to-real gap. Only the grayscale version of the simulated images is used, in the PhysX rigid-body configuration.
blocks.zh: Tactile模拟可以使控制,可再生的数据集没有真正的硬件. TACTO [12],"出租车" [13],"TacSL [14] 从模拟接触中渲染出基于视觉的触觉图像",而"SimTacLS"将这个想法扩展到了大规模触觉皮肤 [15]. 在模拟触觉图像上接受过训练的模型默认不会向真实的传感器转移,并用物理精确的模拟[16]或域相适应[17]来解决缺口. 本研究使用TacEx,将接触模拟和触觉渲染结合到Isaac Sim中为GelSight Mini [18],它把重力作为感兴趣的域变量,而不是sim-to-real差距. 在PhysX硬体配置中,只使用模拟图像的灰色尺度版本.

blocks.en: II-C Tactile Sensing in Space Robotics
blocks.zh: II-C 空间机器人的触控传感器

blocks.en: Space robotic manipulation involves contact-rich tasks such as capture, servicing, assembly, and sample collection, where contact dynamics and ground verification remain major challenges under microgravity and reduced gravity [ 2 ] . Tactile sensing has entered this domain primarily through hardware designed to survive the environment. Jahanshahi and Zhu review resistive, capacitive, piezoelectric, and optical technologies for orbital and planetary platforms [ 3 ] , and the same authors review learning-based grasp control for space [ 19 ] . Fibre-optic tactile pads have been demonstrated on a gripper designed for the Astrobee free-flying robots [ 20 ] , a sensor based on optical-fibre knots measures pressure, hardness, and texture for on-orbit servicing [ 21 ] , and force-sensing grippers have been proposed for on-orbit capture [ 22 ] . Contact experiments have also flown, with gecko-inspired adhesive grippers tested aboard the International Space Station [ 23 ] . That gravity changes the control of a grasp is documented in human studies, where the coordination of grip and load forces adapts differently under Mars, Moon, and microgravity during parabolic flight [ 24 ] . The effect of gravity on the tactile signal itself, on the features that a classifier consumes, has not been measured in any of these works. This study addresses that gap with one representation and one controlled task, so that the observed change can be attributed to gravity, and asks whether rotation-direction classification generalises across gravities without richer tactile images, marker displacement, reconstructed geometry, learned force maps, robot state, or a gravity input.
blocks.zh: 空间机器人操纵涉及捕获、维修、组装和样本收集等内容丰富的接触任务,在这些任务中,接触动态和地面核查仍然是在微重力和降低重力下的主要挑战[2]。 Tactile感知主要通过为生存环境而设计的硬件进入了这个领域. Jahanshahi和Zhu审查轨道和行星平台的阻力、电能、相接电能和光学技术[3],同名作者审查基于学习的空间取控[19]。 在为Astrobee自由飞行机器人设计的抓取器上演示了纤维-光学触控垫 [20],一种基于光学-纤维结的测量压力、硬度和纹理的传感器用于在轨保养 [21],并提议了在轨捕获的强感抓取器 [22]. 接触实验也进行了飞行,国际空间站上测试了受壁球启发的粘接接器。 这种重力改变对接力的控制,在人类研究中被记录下来,在火星,月球,抛物线飞行期间微重力下,握力和负载力的协调不同. [24]. 引力对触觉信号本身的影响,对分类器所消耗的特征的影响,在这些作品中均未被测量出. 本研究用一种表示和一种可控任务来弥补这一差距,这样观察到的变化可以归因于重力,并询问旋转-方向分类是跨越重力的通俗化,而没有更丰富的触觉图像,标记移位,重建几何,学习力图,机器人状态,还是重力输入.

blocks.en: III-C Rotation-Direction Target
blocks.zh: 三-C 旋转方向目标

blocks.en:
The label of an event is the direction of rotation of its contact pattern, cw or ccw , and every flow field of the event carries that label. Because the two pads of the gripper face the object from opposite sides, the same load produces opposite rotation directions on the two sides (Table I ). Each sensor is therefore treated as an
independent sample, while data from both sensors are used to train the
classifier.

独立样本,而两个传感器的数据用于培训
分类者.

blocks.en:
Only the optical-flow representation is provided to the classifier.
Force magnitude, load position, gravity condition, repetition, sensor
side, and frame index are not included as input features.

blocks.en: III-D Feature Selection
blocks.zh: 三-D 特性选择

blocks.en:
The 126-dimensional representation contains the horizontal and
vertical flow medians of the 63 grid cells. Three feature
configurations are evaluated. Configuration A uses the full
representation. Configuration B uses PCA-guided selection:
principal component analysis [ 26 ] identifies the
components explaining 90% of the variance in the training data, and
the original features are ranked according to their contribution to
these components. Configuration C uses minimum redundancy maximum
relevance (mRMR) [ 27 ] , which ranks features by their
relevance to the target while penalising redundancy with previously
selected features. The ranking is truncated at its elbow.
blocks.zh:
126维的表示法包含横向和
63个网格细胞的垂直流中位数。 三个功能
对配置进行评价。 配置 A 使用全
代表权。 配置 B 使用 PCA 引导选择 :
主要组成部分分析[26]
说明培训数据90%差异的部分,以及
原功能按其对
这些组件。 配置 C 使用最小冗余
相关性(mRMR)[27],按特征排列
与目标相关,同时惩罚先前的冗余
选定特性。 排名在肘部被截取.

blocks.en:
Both selection methods retain subsets of the original flow features;
they do not transform the classifier input. Feature selection is
performed using the training set only. In addition, a grid-resolution
ablation evaluates increasingly compact spatial representations and
the contribution of the individual flow components.
blocks.zh:
两种选择方法都保留了原始流程特征的子集;
它们不会转换分类器输入。 特性选择是
仅使用成套培训进行。 此外,还有网格分辨率
缩小对空间表现和
单个流动部分的贡献。

blocks.en: III-E Classifiers and Training
blocks.zh: 三-E 分类和培训

blocks.en:
Four lightweight classifiers are evaluated: XGBoost, random forest,
k-nearest neighbours (KNN), and logistic regression. KNN uses
standardised features, while logistic regression provides a linear
reference. These models are suitable for compact hand-crafted tactile
representations and have been used for related tactile classification
tasks [ 28 ] .
blocks.zh:
4个轻量级分类被评价: XGBoost,随机森林,
k 近邻(KNN),后勤回归。 KNN 用途
标准化特性,物流回归则提供线性
参考文献。 这些型号适合手动紧凑的触觉
表示并用于相关的触觉分类
任务[28]。

blocks.en:
The dataset is divided into 80% training and 20% test data. Splitting
is performed at the trial level and stratified by class, ensuring that
events from the same trial remain in the same partition. This prevents
information from the same trial from appearing in both training and
test sets.
blocks.zh:
该数据集分为80%的培训和20%的测试数据. 分割
在审判一级进行,按班级分类,确保
同一审判事件仍然在同一分区。 这样可以防止
同一审判中提供的关于参加培训和
测试集。

blocks.en:
Two training regimes are evaluated. In the Earth regime, only
Earth-gravity data are used for training, while the test data are
separated by gravity to evaluate Earth performance and transfer to the
unseen Mars, Moon, and orbital domains. In the All regime,
training data include all four gravity conditions. Hyperparameters for XGBoost, random forest, and KNN are selected from
the training set using grouped 3-fold cross-validation with Bayesian
optimisation (Optuna, 12 trials, accuracy criterion). Logistic
regression uses fixed hyperparameters. Each final model is fitted to
the complete training set and evaluated once on the held-out test set. Accuracy per flow field is the primary metric. Balanced accuracy,
macro-F1, ROC-AUC, and PR-AUC [ 29 ] are also
reported.
blocks.zh:
评价了两种培训制度。 在地球制度下,
地球重力数据用于培训,而测试数据用于:
以重力相分离以评价地球性能并转移至
看不见火星、月球和轨道域 在所有政权中,
培训数据包括所有四个重力条件。 XGBoost 、 随机林和 KNN 的超参数从中选择
与贝叶斯人进行3倍的交叉鉴定
优化(Optuna,12个试验,准确性标准)。 后勤
回归使用固定的超参数. 每个最终型号都配有
完整的培训集,并在被搁置的测试集中评估一次。 每个流量字段的精确度是主要衡量标准。 平衡的准确性,
宏观F1、ROC-AUC和PR-AUC[29]也是
报告。

blocks.en: IV Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 四. 实验设置

blocks.en: IV-A Simulation and Load Application
blocks.zh: 模拟和装入应用程序

blocks.en:
The experiments are conducted in the Space Robotics Bench (SRB),
built on Isaac Sim for the development and validation of robotic
systems in space scenarios [ 30 ] . Vision-based
tactile sensing is simulated through TacEx [ 18 ] using its PhysX rigid-body
configuration. In this configuration, the gel pad is represented as
a rigid body with compliant contacts. This configuration provides
stable rendering of contact-pattern rotation over the large number
of trials required in this study, while avoiding additional
deformation effects from a simulated soft gel
(Section VI-D ).
blocks.zh:

在Isaac Sim基础上建立的机器人开发和验证系统
[30]。 基于愿景
触觉感应通过TacEx模拟 [18] 使用其 电线 X 刚体
配置 。 在这个配置中,凝胶垫表示为
一个僵硬的机构 与合规的接触。 此配置提供了
稳定地进行大量接触方式旋转
在避免出现额外案件的情况下
模拟软凝胶的变形效应
(第六-D节)

The simulated setup (Fig. 3 ) consists of a
Franka arm with two vision-based tactile sensors mounted on a parallel
gripper. A metallic profile is grasped horizontally at its centre
between the two sensors. During each trial, the manipulator maintains
a fixed grasp while an external vertical force F z F_{z} is applied to
the profile at a distance d d from the grasp, producing a torque
about an axis parallel to the sensor optical axis.

blocks.en: IV-B Dataset and Partitions
blocks.zh: 四-B 数据集和分区

blocks.en:
Each recording from one tactile sensor during one load application is
treated as an event, giving two events per trial. A total of 3840
events were recorded. The recordings were reviewed to retain events
with measurable contact-pattern rotation and a consistent rotation
direction. Events dominated by linear slip, including cases in which
the profile slid out of the grasp without rotating, were excluded
because linear slip is outside the classification target.
blocks.zh:
在一个负载应用中从一个触觉传感器中录取的每个记录是:
将事件视为事件,每次审判两次。 共计3840
记录了事件。 审查了录音以保留事件
采用可测量的接触方式旋转和连续旋转
向上转 以线性滑行为主的事件,包括
不旋转的剖面滑出控制范围,不包括在内
因为线性滑行不在分类目标之外.

blocks.en:
The resulting dataset contains 2366 events from 1245 trials, with
563–620 events per gravity condition. The two rotation classes are
approximately balanced, with 1232 ccw and 1134 cw events. Optical-flow fields are extracted from the interval in which
the contact pattern rotates, and each field inherits the label of its
event. Table II summarizes the partitions used in the
two training regimes.

563–620次事件每重力状态. 两个轮班是
大约平衡,有1232ccw和1134ccw事件. 光学流场从
每个字段继承其标签
活动。 表二汇总了《京都议定书》
两种培训制度。

blocks.en: V Results
blocks.zh: 五 结果

blocks.en: V-A Gravity-Domain Analysis
blocks.zh: V-A 重力领域分析

blocks.en: The first analysis tests whether gravity changes the optical-flow representation before considering classification performance. The PERMANOVA [ 31 ] measures the joint effect of gravity without assuming any distribution of the features, the Kruskal–Wallis tests [ 32 ] locate it feature by feature, and the False Discovery Rate (FDR) correction [ 33 ] accounts for the 126 comparisons.
blocks.zh: 第一个分析测试重力在考虑分类性能之前是否改变光学-流表达. PERMANOVA [31] 测量重力的连带效应而不假设特征的分布,克罗斯卡尔-瓦利斯测试 [32] 按特征定位其特征,而"假发现率"(FDR)校正 [33] 则说明了126个比较.

blocks.en:
The PERMANOVA shows a statistically significant but small effect of gravity
( R 2 = 0.0164 R^{2}=0.0164 , pseudo- F = 13.12 F=13.12 , p = 0.001 p=0.001 , 999 permutations).
Gravity therefore accounts for approximately 1.6% of the variance in
the representation. Its effect is smaller than those of load position
( R 2 = 0.591 R^{2}=0.591 ), sensor side (0.189), force magnitude (0.055), and
load direction (0.043).
blocks.zh:
PERMANOVA显示,从统计学上看,重力具有显著但很小的作用。
(R 2 = 0.0164 R^{2 = 0.0164;伪-F = 13.12 F = 13.12;p = 0.001 p = 0.001;999通相).
因此,引力约占2004年差异的1.6%。
代表机构。 它的作用比负载位置小
(R 2 = 0.591 R^{2 = 0.591),传感器侧(0.189),强度(0.055),以及
装入方向 (0.043).

blocks.en:
Pairwise tests with FDR correction distinguish Earth from Mars, Moon,
and orbit ( R 2 = 0.017 R^{2}=0.017 –0.020, p = 0.002 p=0.002 ). Mars is also
distinguishable from Moon and orbit ( R 2 = 0.002 R^{2}=0.002 –0.003, p = 0.002 p=0.002 ), whereas Moon and orbit are not
( R 2 = 0.0008 R^{2}=0.0008 , p = 0.53 p=0.53 ). At the feature level, the Kruskal–Wallis tests identify significant gravity effects in 78 of the 126 features, distributed between flow components and multiple grid cells (Fig. 4 ). The largest effect
sizes are ϵ 2 = 0.0595 \epsilon^{2}=0.0595 for d ​ y dy and 0.0579 for d ​ x dx .

Overall, gravity introduces a small but measurable shift
in the optical-flow representation. The following analysis evaluates whether this shift affects classifiers trained only under Earth gravity.

总体而言,重力带来了小而可衡量的变化
在光流表示法中。 以下分析评价这种转移是否影响仅在地心引力下训练的分类器.

blocks.en: V-B Earth-Only Training
blocks.zh: V-B 仅限地球训练

blocks.en:
The Earth-only regime evaluates whether a classifier trained under
Earth gravity transfers to unseen gravity domains. XGBoost achieves
0.944 accuracy on Earth but decreases to 0.858 on Mars, 0.817 on the
Moon, and 0.759 in orbit (Table III and
Fig. 5 (a)). This corresponds to a maximum
accuracy decrease of 0.185.
blocks.zh:
仅限地球制度评价在以下条件下受训的分类员:
地心引力转移到看不见的地心引力域. XGBoost 实现
地球的精确度为0.944,火星为0.858,火星为0.817。
和轨道上的月球和卫星
(图5(a))。 这相当于最大值
准确度下降0.185。

blocks.en:
The same trend appears in all four classifiers. From Earth to orbit, random forest decreases from 0.938 to 0.655, KNN from 0.934 to 0.591, and logistic regression from 0.857 to 0.688. For every classifier, accuracy decreases progressively from Earth to Mars, Moon, and orbit. Balanced accuracy and macro-F1 show the same pattern,
as do ROC-AUC and PR-AUC. These results show that the gravity-domain shift identified in the optical-flow features is accompanied by reduced classification performance when training is restricted to Earth-gravity data.
blocks.zh:
在所有四个分类中都出现了同样的趋势。 从地球到轨道,随机森林从0.938降至0.655,KNN从0.934降至0.591,物流回归从0.857降至0.688. 对于每一个分类器,精确度从地球逐渐降低到火星,月球和轨道. 平衡精确度和宏F1显示的规律相同,
ROC -AUC和PR -AUC也一样 这些结果表明,光流特征所识别的重力领域转移,在训练仅限于地心重力数据时,伴随着分类性能的降低.

blocks.zh: V-C 全重力培训

blocks.en: V-D Minimal Representation
blocks.zh: V-D 最小代表

blocks.en:
The ablation study evaluates how far the optical-flow representation
can be reduced while preserving classification performance. XGBoost
is evaluated with fixed hyperparameters and the same train/test
partition while varying the flow components, grid resolution, and
feature-selection strategy (Table VI and
Fig. 6 ).

分区,同时改变流量组件、网格分辨率和
特性选择策略(表六和表六)

0.925 with 12 features, and a single-cell representation reaches
0.670 with two features. Using only one flow component also reduces
accuracy, to 0.944 for d ​ x dx and 0.947 for d ​ y dy .

blocks.en: V-E Computational Cost
blocks.zh: V-E 计算费用

blocks.en:
Runtime is measured on a single thread of an Intel Core Ultra 7 268V
under Linux. The reported values are therefore machine-dependent and
are intended to characterize the relative computational cost of the
pipeline and classifiers.
blocks.zh:
运行时间是在Intel Core 7 268V的一线测量
在Linux下面。 因此,所报告的数值取决于机器,而且
的相对计算成本
管道和分类器。

blocks.en:
Feature extraction dominates inference time. Farnebäck optical
flow on a 320 × 240 320\times 240 frame requires 10.15 ms, followed by
1.43 ms for the 7 × 9 7\times 9 grid aggregation. In comparison,
XGBoost classification requires only 0.14 ms per flow field
(Table VII ). Logistic regression requires 0.11 ms, KNN
2.19 ms, and random forest 33.62 ms.
blocks.zh:
特征取出主导了推断时间. Farnebäck光学
320×240 320\times 240帧需要10.15 ms,然后
1.43 ms用于7×9 7\times 9网格聚合. 相比之下,
XGBooost 分类每流场只需要0.14毫秒
(表七. ) 后勤回归需要0.11 ms, KNN
2.19 ms,和随机森林 33.62 ms.

blocks.en:
XGBoost also provides the highest classification accuracy in both
training regimes while requiring a 0.4 MB fitted model and 2.07 s
for a single training fit. For this experimental configuration,
classification therefore contributes little to the total processing
time; dense optical-flow computation is the main computational
bottleneck.

blocks.en: VI Discussion
blocks.zh: 六. 讨论情况

blocks.en: VI-A Gravity-Induced Domain Shift
blocks.zh: VI- A 引力域移动

blocks.en:
Gravity has a small effect on the overall variability of the
optical-flow representation but a substantial impact on cross-gravity
classification. The PERMANOVA attributes only 1.6% of the feature
variance to gravity, considerably less than to load position, sensor
side, force magnitude, or load direction. Nevertheless, under
Earth-only training, XGBoost accuracy decreases from 0.944 on Earth
to 0.759 in orbit, with the same degradation trend observed across
all four classifiers.
blocks.zh:
地心引力对电离层的总体可变性影响不大。
光学流表示,但对跨重力有重大影响
分类。 PERMANOVA 属性仅为1.6% 特性
与重力相差,远低于负载位置、传感器
侧面、力能或负载方向。 尽管如此,
仅限地球训练,XGBooost精度从地球上的0.944下降
至轨道上0.759, 整个轨道的降解趋势相同
所有四个分类者。

blocks.en:
These results are not contradictory: a small contribution to the
total feature variance can still affect the feature structure relevant
to the classification boundary. Moreover, the degradation increases
from Mars to Moon and orbit as gravity departs from Earth’s. The two
analyses therefore provide complementary evidence: gravity produces
a small but measurable shift in the tactile representation, and this
shift is associated with substantial performance degradation when
classifiers trained on Earth are transferred to reduced-gravity
domains.
blocks.zh:
这些结果并非自相矛盾:对难民署的贡献很小。
总特性差异仍然会影响相关的特性结构
到分类边界。 此外,退化加剧
从火星到月球和轨道 重力离开地球 两者
因此,分析提供了补充证据:
触觉代表的微小但可衡量的变化,以及
转移与绩效大幅下降有关,如果
在地球上受训的分类人员被转移到了减重力
区域。

blocks.en: VI-B Generalisation Across Gravity Domains
blocks.zh: 跨重力领域通用

blocks.en:
Including all four gravity domains in training results in consistent performance across them. XGBoost achieves 0.963 overall accuracy,
with per-gravity accuracy ranging from 0.951 to 0.970, despite gravity
not being provided as an input. This shows that a single classifier
can operate across the four evaluated gravity domains when they are
represented during training.
blocks.zh:
将所有四个重力领域都纳入培训工作,使培训工作取得一致成果。 XGBoost实现0.963总精度,
每重力精确度在0.951至0.970之间,尽管有重力
未作为投入提供。 显示一个分类器
可在四个受评价的重力领域进行操作,如果它们是:
在培训期间担任代表。

blocks.en:
The Earth-only results also show that sensitivity to the domain shift
depends on the classifier. The maximum accuracy loss ranges from 0.169
for logistic regression to 0.342 for KNN, while XGBoost combines the
highest accuracy with greater robustness to the shift. These results
indicate that cross-gravity performance depends on both the tactile
representation and the classifier used to interpret it.
blocks.zh:
仅以地球为主的结果也表明,对域移的敏感性
取决于分类器。 最大精度损失范围为0.169
KNN的后勤回归为0.342, XGBoost 组合为
最高精度 更坚固的转向。 这些结果
表示交叉重力性能取决于触觉
说明和用来解释它的分类符。

blocks.en: VI-C Minimal Representation and Cost
blocks.zh: 最低代表性和费用

blocks.en:
The representation can be substantially reduced with little loss in
accuracy. A 4 × 5 4\times 5 grid reduces the feature set from 126 to 40
while decreasing accuracy only from 0.963 to 0.957. More aggressive
compression produces a clearer trade-off: mRMR retains 0.939 accuracy
with 14 features, whereas a single-cell representation falls to 0.670.
blocks.zh:
代表人数可以大幅度减少,但很少减少。
准确性。 4×5 4\times 5个网格将设置的特性从126个减少到40个
准确度从0.963降至0.957。 更冲动
压缩产生更明确的取舍:mRMR保留了0.939的精度
拥有14个特征,而单细胞代表为0.670个.

blocks.en:
The main computational cost, however, remains in feature extraction.
Farnebäck optical flow and grid aggregation require approximately
11.6 ms per frame pair, compared with only 0.14 ms for XGBoost
inference. A coarser grid therefore reduces the representation size,
but further runtime improvements would require reducing the cost of
the optical-flow computation itself.
blocks.zh:
但是,主要的计算费用仍然是特征提取。
Farnebäck光学流和电网集聚大约需要
每帧11.6毫秒,而XGBoost仅0.14毫秒
推论. 因此,同心电网减少了代表规模,
但是,为了进一步改善运行时间,需要降低
光学流计算本身。

blocks.en: VI-D Limitations
blocks.zh: VI-D 限制

blocks.en:
Two limitations bound these findings. First, the study is
simulation-based and uses a rigid gel model. A deformable gel may produce different optical-flow responses, so validation with a real tactile sensor is needed. Second, the classifier is sensitive to sensor orientation. Deployment with different orientations would therefore require a consistent image reference frame or orientation-diverse training data.
blocks.zh:
这些结论有两个限制。 首先,研究是
基于模拟并使用刚性凝胶模型. 可变形凝胶可能会产生不同的光学-流响应,因此需要用真正的触觉传感器进行验证. 第二,分类器对传感器取向敏感. 因此,采用不同取向的部署需要连贯一致的图像参考框架或定向多样化培训数据。

blocks.en: VII Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 七. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en:
This simulation study investigated whether a compact optical-flow representation can classify load-induced rotation and transfer across gravity domains. The 126-feature representation achieves 0.963 accuracy, while a reduced 40-feature grid retains 0.957. Although gravity accounts for only 1.6% of the feature variance, classifiers
trained only on Earth data degrade under reduced gravity, with XGBoost accuracy decreasing from 0.944 on Earth to 0.759 in orbit. In contrast, a single model trained across all four gravity domains achieves consistent performance in each domain without using gravity as an input. XGBoost inference requires only 0.14 ms, with dense optical-flow computation remaining the main computational cost.
blocks.zh:
这项模拟研究调查了一种紧凑的光流表示能否对负载引起的自转和跨重力域的转移进行分类。 126地平面代表实现0.963精度,而被缩小的40地平面网格保留了0.957. 虽然重力只占特性差异的1.6%,但分类器
只在地球数据上经过培训后在受重力降低后降解,XGBoost精度从地球上的0.944降至轨道上的0.759. 相形之下,在所有四个重力领域都经过培训的单一模型在不使用重力作为投入的情况下,在每个领域都取得了一致的性能. XGBooost推论只需要0.14 ms,而密集的光流计算仍然是主要计算成本.

blocks.en:
These results show that Earth-gravity performance alone is
insufficient to establish the transferability of tactile perception for space robotic manipulation. They also show that a compact representation can preserve most of the classification performance across the evaluated gravity conditions. Future work will focus on real-sensor validation, transfer to unseen gravity conditions, and
extension to a broader range of contact events, loading conditions, and object geometries.
blocks.zh:
这些结果表明,地球重力性能本身就是
不足以确定空间机器人操纵的触觉感知的可转移性。 它们也表明,紧凑的表示方式可以在整个评价的重力条件下保持大多数分类业绩。 今后的工作将侧重于实感验证、转移到看不见的重力条件下,以及
扩展到更广泛的接触事件、加载条件和对象几何。
